explanationKey: Asks for an upfront processing fee or money deposit. Official government welfare schemes are ALWAYS 100% free to apply.
Demands an OTP, bank PIN, or secret credentials. Government portals and officials will NEVER ask you to reveal an OTP.
Uses an unofficial or shortened web link. Genuine Indian government web portals strictly end in '.gov.in' or '.nic.in'.
Creates artificial panic and urgency to force the citizen into acting without verification.
Promises unexpected lottery or prize payouts disguised as welfare benefits.
